controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres negatifs de 2 784,6 M$ ; dette totale 9,058 Md$ ; tresorerie 253,7 M$ ; emission de 850 M$ de Senior Notes 4,950% echeance 2031 le 14 juillet 2026 ; dette ajustee/EBITDAR stable a 2,5x
controles.verbatim_source: Total stockholders' deficit (2,784,552) ; Total debt before discounts and debt issuance costs 9,058,000 ; 253,729 ; 'On July 14, 2026, AutoZone, Inc. completed the sale of $850,000,000 million aggregate principal amount of its 4.950% Senior Notes due 2031' (8-K, le 'million' surnumeraire figure bien dans le depot) ; 'our adjusted debt to ... EBITDAR ... ratio ... was 2.5:1 as of May 9, 2026, and May 10, 2025'

controles.affirmation: 40,7 Md$ de rachats autorises depuis 1998 ; 1,3 Md$ rachetes sur les 36 semaines closes le 9 mai 2026 ; 0,8 Md$ d'autorisation restante
controles.verbatim_source: the Board voted to authorize the repurchase of an additional $1.5 billion ... which raised the total value of shares authorized to be repurchased to $40.7 billion. Considering the cumulative repurchases as of May 9, 2026, the Company had $0.8 billion remaining ... including 356.3 thousand shares ... at an aggregate cost of $1.3 billion during the thirty-six week period ended May 9, 2026

controles.affirmation: ROIC ajuste apres impot tombe a 36,3% sur les quatre derniers trimestres contre 43,5% un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: For the trailing four quarters ended May 9, 2026, our adjusted after-tax return on invested capital ('ROIC') ... was 36.3% as compared to 43.5% for the comparable prior year period.

controles.affirmation: Ratio dettes fournisseurs sur stocks de 111,1% au 9 mai 2026 contre 115,6% un an plus tot ; arrangements conclus par les fournisseurs a leur seule discretion
controles.verbatim_source: We had an accounts payable to inventory ratio of 111.1% at May 9, 2026, and 115.6% at May 10, 2025.

controles.affirmation: Ventes comparables internationales +16,6% publiees et seulement +1,6% a change constant sur 12 semaines ; +15,0% contre +2,6% sur 36 semaines ; -9,2% publiees un an plus tot
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance disponible mais non utilisee : a change constant, les comparables internationales DECELERENT (de +8,1% a +1,6% sur 12 semaines, de +10,4% a +2,6% sur 36 semaines), ce qui renforce l'argument.

controles.affirmation: Reserve LIFO de 260,0 M$ au 9 mai 2026 contre 83,0 M$ au 30 aout 2025, hausse attribuee a l'inflation portee par les tarifs ; Cour supreme a invalide les tarifs IEEPA le 20 fevrier 2026, remplaces par de nouveaux tarifs de portee incertaine
controles.verbatim_source: Due to price changes on the Company's merchandise purchases, primarily due to inflation driven by tariffs, the Company's LIFO credit reserve balance was $260.0 million at May 9, 2026, and $83.0 million at August 30, 2025. / On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ('IEEPA'). The President immediately introduced new tariffs under different statutory authority, though their scope and duration ... remain uncertain.

controles.affirmation: 'la societe reconnait elle-meme dans son dossier de risques que certains concurrents disposent de ressources financieres superieures et investissent davantage dans l'IA et les strategies omnicanales'
controles.verbatim_source: Although we believe we compete effectively, our competitors may have greater financial resources allowing them to invest more in their business, greater sourcing capabilities ... and more successful utilization of data analytics, artificial intelligence and other new and emerging technologies.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-K emploie le conditionnel ('may have') dans un facteur de risque : ce n'est pas un constat mais une eventualite, et la phrase precedente affirme au contraire 'we believe we compete effectively'. Le terme omnicanal ne vise pas non plus les concurrents mais l'execution propre d'AutoZone. Reformuler : 'la societe indique que ses concurrents POURRAIENT disposer de ressources financieres superieures et faire un usage plus efficace de l'analyse de donnees et de l'intelligence artificielle'.
